caveats: BEAST detects changepoints in NBR, not tree survival or a specific agent.
No published BEAST-to-AOS severity mapping is applied; severity_class is unknown.
HLS-only composites start in 2013 (L30) and 2015 (S30); Brown et al. used Landsat from 2000.
A BEAST detection is not a validated AOS polygon match unless a separate validation join is supplied.
